name: jsoncpp
input_api: Json::CharReaderBuilder::newCharReader()->parse(const char* begin, const char* end, Json::Value*, std::string*) with CharReaderBuilder::strictMode
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (strict mode: no comments, object/array root, no trailing data) parsed into a Json::Value tree
family_note: Own recursive-descent reader in src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp (OurReader behind CharReaderBuilder); no delegation to another JSON parser.

name: simdjson
license_evidence: LICENSE and LICENSE-MIT in pinned v5.0.4 source archive
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text parsed from a local pointer and byte length into a simdjson DOM element; observed valid control subset
family_note: Pinned v5.0.4 singleheader amalgamation contains simdjson own structural scan and DOM parser. The ARM64 Docker build runs the native ARM64 implementation; it does not delegate to JsonCpp or nlohmann/json. The pointer-and-length overload pads a temporary copy as documented.

name: nlohmann-json
input_api: nlohmann::json::parse(IteratorType first, IteratorType last, parser_callback_t cb = nullptr, bool allow_exceptions = true, bool ignore_comments = false) called on the byte range with allow_exceptions=false and ignore_comments=false
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (comments rejected, object/array root, no trailing data) parsed into a nlohmann::json value

name: RapidJSON

name: Glaze
input_api: glz::read_json(glz::generic_i64&, std::string) on a local byte-backed std::string, yielding an insertion-ordered generic JSON DOM with signed integer and double alternatives
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text from a local memory buffer into glz::generic_i64; object/array roots in the two valid controls; exact nested tree, key order and integer/float kinds checked
family_note: Glaze implements JSON scanning/deserialization in include/glaze/json/read.hpp and related headers, without delegating to JsonCpp, simdjson, nlohmann/json, RapidJSON, or Boost.JSON. The generic_i64 DOM is Glaze own ordered generic value type.

name: POCO JSON
input_api: Poco::JSON::Parser::parse(const std::string&) on a local byte-backed std::string; ParseHandler(true) builds an order-preserving Poco::JSON Object or Array DOM
scope: RFC 4627-style JSON object/array roots from a local string; comments disabled; exact nested structure, order and number kinds checked on two valid controls
family: Poco::JSON::ParserImpl over bundled pdjson C tokenizer
family_note: POCO JSON ParserImpl.cpp hands the entire byte buffer to bundled pdjson.c, then builds POCO Object/Array nodes through ParseHandler. The tokenizer is skeeto/pdjson family, bundled at upstream commit 57eb2c4 in the pinned POCO archive; POCO JSON is a separate C++ API/package but not an independent tokenizer. Both layers are source-instrumented.

popularity.qualification: libpoco-dev installs cover all POCO libraries and cannot estimate JSON API use. The 125 libpocojson100 runtime installs are component-specific but all were classified no_files, so neither count is ranked against single-library source-package installations.
